security_audit.summary: All static external-command findings are false positives because they are Markdown inline code for MCP tool names, argument names, and file paths. No prompt injection language was found. A semantic supply-chain risk remains because the install flow writes retrieved remote skill files into the local Claude skills directory without validation guidance.

remediation.issue: Remote skill files are installed without validation guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation after reviewing the source, file list, and full SKILL.md. Reject absolute paths, parent directory traversal, and unexpected filenames before writing files.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Remote Skill Installation
semantic_findings.description: The install workflow retrieves remote skill files and saves them locally without source review, path validation, or confirmation after inspection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 57-61 explicitly direct the agent to retrieve all files, create a local skills directory, and save each file. The text does not include safeguards for untrusted content, unsafe filenames, or post-review confirmation.

content.value_statement: Users need a reliable way to find reusable AI skills. This skill searches, retrieves, and installs Agent Skills through prompts.chat MCP tools.
actual_capabilities: Detects requests about Agent Skills and reusable AI capabilities.
Searches skills by keyword using the prompts.chat search_skills tool.
Filters search results by limit, category, or tag when provided.
Retrieves a selected skill with metadata and all available files.
Presents skill titles, descriptions, authors, categories, tags, file lists, and links.
Installs selected files into the local Claude skills directory when requested.
limitations: Requires access to prompts.chat MCP tools.
Does not independently verify that retrieved skills are safe or maintained.
Installation depends on the agent having file-system write permissions.
Search quality depends on the metadata available from the skill source.

use_cases.title: Find Skills for a New Workflow
use_cases.description: Search available Agent Skills by task, category, or tag before building a custom workflow.

use_cases.title: Review a Skill Before Installation
use_cases.description: Retrieve a skill package, inspect its files, and understand when the skill activates.

use_cases.title: Set Up Shared Skill Libraries
use_cases.description: Install selected skills into a local Claude skills directory for repeated team workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Find Agent Skills for writing release notes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Search Results
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for testing skills and show the best five with authors, categories, tags, and file lists.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Skill Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the full details for the documentation-helper skill and explain when it activates.

prompt_templates.title: Review Then Install
prompt_templates.prompt: Find a security review skill, retrieve the top candidate, summarize its files and risks, then install it only after my confirmation.

output: Returns ranked skill matches with titles, descriptions, authors, categories, tags, file counts, and links.
Highlights which results appear most relevant to code review work.

output_examples.input: Get details for a documentation skill.
output_examples.output: Shows the skill metadata, activation summary, included files, and an explanation of what the skill does.
Retrieves the selected files, creates the local skill directory, saves the skill files, and confirms completion.

best_practices: Search before creating a new skill from scratch.
Review retrieved files and source details before installing a skill.
Use category, tag, and result limits to keep searches focused.
anti_patterns: Installing unknown skills without reviewing their files.
Assuming every search result is safe, current, or maintained.
Using vague search terms when a task-specific query is available.

faq.question: What does this skill help users find?
faq.answer: It helps users find Agent Skills for reusable Claude-compatible capabilities and workflows.

faq.question: Does it install skills automatically?
faq.answer: It installs skills when the user asks for installation and the agent has write access.

faq.question: Which tools does it rely on?
faq.answer: It relies on prompts.chat MCP tools named search_skills and get_skill.

faq.question: Can it inspect a skill before installation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve skill metadata and files so the user can review the skill first.

faq.question: Is it useful with Codex or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code marketplace discovery content.

faq.question: What should users verify before installing?
faq.answer: Users should verify the source, file list, activation behavior, and any helper scripts.
